speaker: client
text: If you have the time and are willing to take on another project, I'd like us to create the cheapest possible single-board version of this design. All functions would be placed on one board, and from the beginning we would try to use JLCPCB Basic components wherever possible. It should require far fewer connectors because there would be no interboard connectors. Please also suggest any changes that could make the design better or cheaper while preserving the same functionality. We can add this as a new milestone to the current project once we agree on the price. Do you think that approach makes sense?

speaker: client
text: Regarding AXP2101, is there a simpler way to handle the power system? The battery must be chargeable while the device is operating, and both 3.3V and 5V rails are required. If a better and simpler implementation exists, please suggest it.

speaker: client
text: Above all, the design must use the battery efficiently so the device can operate for as long as possible.

speaker: client
text: Although AXP provides exactly the functionality I need and includes advanced features, it also requires many static external components, so I am unsure whether to retain it. I know about TP4056 and similar alternatives, but I do not think they handle charging and powering the system simultaneously very well.
